title: Counterfactual Cultural Cues Reduce Medical QA Accuracy in LLMs: Identifier vs Context Effects

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual evaluation using medical multiple-choice questions (MedQA) augmented with clinically non-decisive cultural identifiers and contextual cues (targeting Indigenous Canadian, Middle-Eastern Muslim, and Southeast Asian backgrounds), measuring drops in diagnostic accuracy, answer flip rates, and utilizing an LLM-as-judge to detect culturally-induced reasoning errors.
